featured_reviews.name: Vinayak Londhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chotu’s Gola & Milkshake, 5 Gardens, Wadala

I recently visited Chotu’s Gola & Milkshake at 5 Gardens, Wadala, and it turned out to be a refreshing stop during my visit. I tried their Kala Khatta Gola, and I must say it was absolutely fantastic—full of flavor, tangy, and exactly the kind of taste you expect from a perfect gola. The ice was crushed well, the syrup was balanced, and overall it was very refreshing.

The only downside is that it feels slightly overpriced, as one Kala Khatta Gola costs ₹50, which is higher than usual street gola rates. However, considering that 5 Gardens doesn’t have many food stalls or shops around, the pricing may be influenced by the location.

The shop offers a good variety of flavours, not just in golas but also in milkshakes, mojitos, and other drinks. So whether you want something icy, creamy, or refreshing, there are multiple choices available. The stall is situated between the sandwich stall and the pani puri stall, making it easy to spot if you’re walking around 5 Gardens.

Chotu’s Gola & Milkshake usually opens around 3 PM and stays open till approximately 9 PM, which works perfectly for evening strolls or casual meetups in the garden area.

Overall, my experience was good—the gola was tasty, the flavors were strong, and it was perfect for the evening. If you’re in 5 Gardens, Wadala, and craving something refreshing, Chotu’s is definitely worth a try.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Cafe Madras is one of the most iconic South Indian restaurants in Mumbai and truly lives up to its reputation. Located in the heart of Matunga, this place is famous for serving authentic and delicious South Indian food with consistent quality for decades. The moment you enter, the aroma of fresh filter coffee, ghee, and spices creates a warm and nostalgic feeling.
I tried their famous dosa and idli, and both were excellent. The dosa was perfectly crispy with a flavorful potato filling, while the idli was soft, fresh, and served with tasty chutneys and sambhar. Their filter coffee was another highlight — strong, aromatic, and refreshing. Despite being crowded most of the time, the service is quick and efficient, which is impressive.
The restaurant maintains cleanliness and has a simple yet traditional atmosphere that adds to the experience. Prices are also reasonable considering the quality and popularity of the food. Overall, Cafe Madras is a must-visit place for anyone who loves authentic South Indian cuisine. It perfectly combines taste, tradition, and quality, making every visit memorable.

🍊 100% Orange Juice (5/5) – No gimmicks, no additives—just freshly squeezed, pure orange juice. Simple, classic, and absolutely perfect.

🍦 Frozen Yogurt (5/5) – DO NOT leave without trying this! We had the Chocolate & Strawberry Frozen Yogurt, and let’s just say—it’s on another level. Creamy, rich, and guilt-free, it’s the perfect sweet treat.

Final Verdict: If you want to eat to your heart’s content without compromising on health, Smoothie Factory is the place to be. Fresh, flavorful, and packed with nutrition—what more could you ask for?
